entities.name: Hugues Quiéret
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugues Quiéret was a French military officer. He was a knight, lord of Tours-en-Vimeu and of Hamicourt, both in Picardy. Before becoming an admiral, he was an advisor, Chamberlain, Grand Master of France, then the seneschal of Beaucaire and Nimes from 1325 to 1332.
